This is my perennial plot, small, just twenty tiimad. I have kept it this way for many years — enset and some fruit trees together, as my father did. I put cattle manure on it when I can, but chemical fertilizer is not something we put on trees here, and I have no cash to waste on it anyway. At my age I work slowly but steadily, and my family helps with weeding and harvest; I have no money to hire labor for a plot this small.
